clue.text: Hanger-on rejected by society locally

indicators.note: rejected says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A social climber is snubbed by the neighbourhood's smart set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rejected' sends the run ETYLOCA, sitting across 'societY LOCAlly', backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An attendant or devoted follower who clings to a leader is a hanger-on.

clue.text: A right racket in California for a papal adviser

indicators.note: in places the first group of letters inside the abbreviation for the state

parts.note: a din is a loud racket or noise

explanation.surface: Someone advising the Pope is pictured making a noisy fuss in California.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinals are senior Catholic clergy who advise the Pope and elect his successor.

clue.text: Unbalanced team after cut beginning to despair

indicators.note: after puts the word for team following the word for cut

parts.note: to lop is to cut off
a side is a sports team

indicators.note: beginning to asks for the opening letter of the word despair

explanation.surface: A team dropped from a competition is left unbalanced and close to despair.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lopsided leans to one side, being uneven or out of balance.

clue.text: Republican must be in however unfashionable everywhere

indicators.note: must be in says the abbreviation goes inside the word for however

parts.note: though can mean however, as in 'he came, though'
out means no longer in fashion

explanation.surface: A Republican insists on being included, however unfashionable he may be anywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Throughout means in every part, so it can stand for everywhere, as in 'known throughout the land'.

clue.text: Document obtained by way of covering letters at last

indicators.note: covering means the word for by way of wraps around the picked letter

parts.note: via means by way of

indicators.note: at last asks for the final letter of the word letters

explanation.surface: A document finally arrives through the post wrapped in its covering letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A visa is an official endorsement in a passport, a travel document permitting entry.

clue.text: The girl Olivier regularly used will be put off

parts.note: she refers to a girl

indicators.note: regularly used asks for every other letter of the name Olivier, starting with its second

explanation.surface: A young actress who often relied on Olivier's methods will be postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shelve a plan is to postpone or defer it, as if laying it aside on a shelf.

clue.text: Hear bet is off and get some air

indicators.note: is off suggests the letters of hear bet have gone wrong, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hearing a wager is cancelled, a punter steps outside for fresh air.
explanation.definitionFit: Breathing means taking air into the lungs, an idiom-like match for getting some air.

clue.text: Models make fun of highs

parts.note: to mock is to make fun of
ups are highs, as in ups and downs

explanation.surface: Fashion models ridicule people who are high on drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Mock-ups are full-scale or scale replicas, prototype models of a design.

clue.text: So far from success, others mostly adjusted

parts.note: a hit is a success, like a hit song

indicators.note: adjusted says the remaining letters are rearranged
mostly means most of the word others is kept, losing its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: Someone reflects that, until now, their success came from others' adjustments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mostly' trims OTHERS to OTHER, which 'adjusted' rearranges as HERTO.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto is a formal word meaning up to this point in time, so far.

clue.text: Get ready to slim down after purge, oddly

indicators.note: after puts the word for slim down following the picked letters
oddly asks for the odd-numbered letters of the word purge

parts.note: to pare is to trim or slim down

explanation.surface: A dieter prepares to lose weight after a strange purge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' takes the first, third and fifth letters of 'purge': PRE.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare is to make ready, so it fits get ready.

clue.text: Sort of figure dog does this to keep everybody quiet

indicators.note: to keep means the dog's noise holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a dog's typical noise is a bark
all means everybody
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: A dog barks at a crowd to make everyone go quiet, oddly.
explanation.walkthrough: The dog's sound is cut open after BA to hold ALL and P.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballpark figure is a rough estimate, so ballpark describes a kind of number.

clue.text: Death of British Trident designed to protect Spain

indicators.note: to protect means the rearranged letters surround the letter for Spain
designed means the letters of Trident are newly arranged

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: The Trident nuclear missile, built to defend Spain, could bring death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Designed' rearranges TRIDENT as ITTERND, which 'to protect' wraps round E.
explanation.definitionFit: The bitter end is the very last stage, often a painful finish such as death.

clue.text: The setter's back story prior to university environment

indicators.note: prior to places the word for story before the letter for university
back means the contraction for the setter's is turned round

parts.note: the setter's means I'm, from the crossword compiler's point of view
a lie is a made-up story

explanation.surface: The crossword setter recalls his background before going to university.
explanation.definitionFit: A milieu is a social setting or surroundings, an environment someone lives in.

clue.text: Lose job in area away from cheap ghetto in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble suggests the remaining letters are disturbed, so they are rearranged
away from means the letter for area is taken out of the following phrase

explanation.surface: Someone loses work and moves out of a poor, troubled district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Away from' removes A from CHEAP GHETTO, and 'in trouble' rearranges the remaining letters CHEPGHETTO.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting the chop is informal for being sacked, which means losing your job.

clue.text: Fortuitous, then, as even after a fashion?

indicators.note: after a fashion suggests the letters are only roughly arranged, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wry remark that something is lucky, then, even after a fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaven-sent describes something that arrives at a lucky moment, as if a gift from above.

clue.text: Having nothing on — save time, ultimately

parts.note: bar can mean except or save, as in 'all bar one'

indicators.note: ultimately asks for the last letter of the word time

explanation.surface: Someone naked advises saving time in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Bare means unclothed, so it describes a person wearing no clothes.

clue.text: Animal that's roamed about in parched environment?

indicators.note: environment means the word for parched surrounds the rearranged letters

parts.note: dry means parched

indicators.note: about signals the letters of roamed are rearranged

explanation.surface: A beast that has wandered around in desert country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' rearranges ROAMED as ROMEDA, which DRY surrounds. The question mark flags how fitting the whole picture is.
explanation.definitionFit: A dromedary is the one-humped Arabian camel, an animal of hot deserts.

clue.text: Hunger may be variable before making money

indicators.note: before places the variable's letter ahead of the word for making money

parts.note: Y is a letter used for a variable in algebra
earning is making money

explanation.surface: A worker's appetite changes before they start bringing in an income.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunger can mean a strong craving or longing, the same sense as yearning.

clue.text: Drink, seeing emancipation with no sign of hesitation

indicators.note: with no means the hesitation sound is removed

parts.note: liberation means emancipation
er is the sound people make when they hesitate

explanation.surface: A drink is downed to toast freedom, with no hesitation.
explanation.definitionFit: A libation is a drink offered to a god, or jokingly any alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Rice, e.g. squeezed by stone, must be best

indicators.note: squeezed by means the name is pressed inside the gem

parts.note: an opal is a precious stone
Tim Rice is the lyricist, so Rice is an example of a Tim

explanation.surface: Rice pressed under a stone, perhaps in a recipe, must be the best method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rice' is not the grain: Tim Rice wrote the lyrics for musicals such as Evita.
explanation.definitionFit: Optimal means the most favourable or ideal, a synonym for best.

clue.text: Captain initially going south for these fish

indicators.note: initially going south means the first letter of the word for captain moves to the bottom of this down entry

parts.note: a skipper is a captain

explanation.surface: A captain sets off south first, heading for a catch of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Kippers are smoked herrings, a type of fish eaten at breakfast in Britain.

clue.text: Ruler seeing eastern border moving westwards

indicators.note: moving westwards means the word for border is read right to left in this across entry

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A ruler sees the eastern frontier being pushed westwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim ruler or prince, especially in the Middle East.

clue.text: Person investigating needing to put watch on soldier

indicators.note: on means the word for watch is placed after the word for soldier in this across entry

parts.note: a private is a soldier of the lowest rank
to eye is to watch

explanation.surface: An investigator needs to keep a soldier under surveillance.
explanation.definitionFit: A private eye is a private detective, someone hired to investigate.

clue.text: Copper's taken in by expert put on trial

indicators.note: taken in by means the copper letters sit inside the word for expert

parts.note: an ace is an expert
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, plus the S of the 's

explanation.surface: A police officer conned by a skilled fraudster ends up facing trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a police officer, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: To accuse is to charge with an offence, the first step to being put on trial.

clue.text: New exam must include end of term average

indicators.note: must include means the word for exam holds the picked letter inside

parts.note: an oral is a spoken exam

indicators.note: end of asks for the last letter of the word term

explanation.surface: A new exam must cover the term-end results, giving an average.
explanation.definitionFit: Normal and average both mean usual or typical.

clue.text: Independent politician played a part and had an effect

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament, a politician
acted means played a part on stage

explanation.surface: An independent MP performed a role and made a difference.
explanation.definitionFit: Impacted, in modern usage, means affected or made a difference to something.

clue.text: Most recent unprotected animals?

indicators.note: unprotected means the word for most recent loses its outside letters, as if stripped of a cover

parts.note: newest means most recent

explanation.surface: The newest arrivals in a flock have been left vulnerable.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewes are female sheep, a specific kind of animal.

clue.text: People in a particular house may find cars parked by empty garage

indicators.note: parked by places the cars next to the remaining letters
empty means the inside of the word garage is removed, keeping its first and last letters

parts.note: Minis are small British cars

explanation.surface: A household might discover small cars parked beside an empty garage.
explanation.definitionFit: Geminis are people born under the Twins, one of the astrological houses or signs.

clue.text: Stopped and relaxed after a run

indicators.note: after places the word for relaxed after the letters for a run

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
rested means relaxed

explanation.surface: An athlete stopped and took a rest after going for a run.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrested means halted or checked, as in arrested development.

clue.text: Presenting a party of men full of spirit

indicators.note: full of means the word for party holds the spirit inside

parts.note: a stag is a party for men only, held before a wedding
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Putting on a show for a men's party that is full of drink.
explanation.walkthrough: A STAG party is a British pre-wedding night out for the groom and his male friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Staging a play is presenting it on stage.
